init_woi_search_query_teacher: initialize WoiSearchQueryTeacher with opt dict to configure search query mutators for Parlai dialogue agents
override_mutators_in_teacher: override the mutators option in WoiSearchQueryTeacher to chain flatten, prompt_search_query, and skip_retrieval mutators
configure_only_last_search_query: set only_last_search_query option to True in WoiSearchQueryTeacher to filter dialogue acts
extend_search_query_teacher: extend SearchQueryTeacher as a subclass of WoiSearchQueryTeacher for custom SeeKeR task variants
use_default_teacher: use DefaultTeacher as the entry point for the SeeKeR search query task in Parlai
